posts.cooked:
BARON BLADE - Don't Stand So Close to Me! - ROUND 1

Baron Blade (30) [Mad Bomber]
Start of Turn:
- Baron Blade fires squibs at everyone doing 0 fire damage (while laughing maniacally)

Play:
Flesh-Repair Nanites - no effect

End of Turn:
Slash and Burn, Living Force Field, and Backlash Field moved under Baron Blade's card

Cards Under Baron Blade: 3
========================
Effects:
- Whenever a villain target enters play, put it under Baron Blade's card and play the top card of the villain deck (Baron Blade)
- Cards under Baron Blade's card are indestructible and are not considered in play.
- When Baron Blade would be destroyed, flip Baron Blade's card instead.

(Start of Turn)
- Baron Blade deals each non-villain target X fire damage where X = the number of cards under Baron Blade's card (Baron Blade)

(End of Turn)
- Move the top 3 cards of the villain deck to under Baron Blade's card (adv Baron Blade)

==========
Baron Blade (30) [Mad Bomber]

Trash:
Flesh Repair Nanites
Under:
Slash and Burn, Living Force Field, and Backlash Field
==========
Argent Adept  - 25
GI Bunker     - 27
Naturalist    - 29
Wraith        - 26
Nightmist     - 27

===========
(no environment cards in play)
 

Comment: Wow.  That was sort of weak.

The Argent Adept is up.
